title: NSC study on disclosure of recovered craft under George W. Bush
place_text: National Security Council; Office of Net Assessment

tellings.quote: Now, you know, there was a report that um that the National Security Council under uh George W. Bush did commission a study of whether the time was had come for quote disclosure

plain: There was reportedly a study, ordered by the National Security Council, the White House's top security advisers, under President George W. Bush, asking whether the time had come for "disclosure" of recovered craft. The former Senate staffer Kirk McConnell relays it, citing Sean Kirkpatrick, who once led the Pentagon office for unexplained aerial reports, and linking the study to a Pentagon think tank called the Office of Net Assessment. If true, it would mean the White House seriously weighed telling the public about such craft.
